description: Live FOC-to-six-step handover at 898 rad/s el with the 250 us blanking still in place. The detector commutates with the rotor for five sectors - the idle-phase ramps are textbook, +/-1.5 V about the measured mid, crossing mid-window - then one crossing arrives at window entry, inside the blank, and the drive desyncs and trips.
notes: First measurement of the idle-phase signal on a SYNCHRONIZED rotor at speed: the sensing works; the low-speed artifact floor does not extrapolate up.
The failure is timing, not signal: 250 us of blanking is 21% of a 1.17 ms window, while demag on this motor needs ~2.5 us.
title: Handover tracks 5 sectors, then the blank swallows a crossing
